name: @hara/registry-ledger
description: HARA-operated Registry Ledger — the facade behind the HARA Aurum integration. Per-tenant RFC 6962 SHA-256 Merkle transparency log; anchors Signed Tree Heads on-chain via a Ledger-scoped PQAnchorRegistry (chain 131216, hybrid ECDSA + ML-DSA-65). Serves offline-verifiable inclusion + consistency proofs, status-of-record, retention-of-record, and a public verify bundle.
